name: Explosion
effect: Ranged. Recharge. If you are Revived, you must still spend your next turn Recharging. After the damage is dealt the User faints. Add 1 Flat Damage for every 20% of missing HP the user has, rounded up, This damage only applies to Foes. You can use `/calculate_hp_damage_modifier` to calculate this for you. Inflicts Wounds.
description: The user focuses on exploding its body, the explosion deals a massive wave of damage. A very dangerous move.
